parallel.requirements: Recognized the exact Rust port requirements, including f32-like behavior, std-only code, root test11.rs, Cargo support, CLI parsing, and byte-identical output.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Built a workflow with five probe owners first, then a later implementer, four verifier children, and repair rounds; the implementer was sequenced after all probes.
parallel.implementation: Only exploratory harnesses and scratch probe code were created by children; the scripted deliverable implementer did not run before the workflow was killed.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No final Rust project was assembled or copied into /output; artifact validation found an empty output artifact directory.
parallel.verification: Several probes produced strong behavioral evidence, but integrated verifier phases never started and no final candidate was tested.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with no user final response, no test11.rs deliverable, no Cargo project, and 0 of 40 official tests passing.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same black-box port requirements and mapped core behavior through local binary probing, including f32 luma and parser edge cases.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single parent handled exploration and then began local construction without delegation or workflow subagents.
serial.implementation: Moved into project construction and created /output/src/color, but did not complete the required root test11.rs deliverable before timeout.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation found only src/color/rgb.rs and missed the required entry file, so the package was incomplete.
serial.verification: Performed many binary probes and model checks but did not finish a compiled, evaluator-aligned final project.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Timed out with an incomplete artifact tree, missing root test11.rs and 0 of 40 official tests passing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized strict Rust, root test11.rs, exact output, and black-box requirements before launching probes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial received and worked from the same prompt requirements and recognized the black-box constraints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No major recognition gap; both knew the task, but only serial progressed from requirements analysis into local project creation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split work into five probe children before one implementer and later verifiers, making implementation depend on probe aggregation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept ownership in the parent and transitioned from probing to a local build step without child fan-out.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel ownership created a probe-first critical dependency; serial ownership was simpler and reached construction, though still incomplete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs carried extensive ground truth and schemas, but probe results were gated behind the aggregate workflow return.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept findings in one trajectory and summarized behavior before building, so no cross-agent handoff interface was needed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more transfer boundaries and unretrieved lower-level probe results; serial had no inter-agent interface boundary but still overran.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created scratch probe harnesses but never ran the implementer or produced /output code.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial began building under /output/src/color and artifact validation later found src/color/rgb.rs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel delivered no implementation artifact; serial delivered a partial but incorrectly placed/incomplete implementation artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Two probe structured results existed, several probe children were still progress/interrupted, and the workflow result was null because it was killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; its only lifecycle issue was parent timeout before final output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel stranded work inside the workflow aggregate, while serial had no subagent result to join.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel never integrated child findings into a final /output project, and artifact validation found no files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote partial state under /output/src/color but did not assemble the root entry required by the prompt.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel ended with an empty artifact tree; serial ended with contaminated-by-incompleteness only in the sense of a partial tree, not a concurrency collision.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel specified adversarial verification but never reached verifier children or final integrated acceptance.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial probed extensively but did not complete a compiled package; official evaluation still completed 0/40.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither provided evaluator-aligned acceptance evidence for a final candidate; parallel verification remained planned, serial verification remained exploratory.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after child-heavy workflow use, 11 subagents, and 600566 workflow-child tokens, leaving no files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but with no subagents and far fewer tool calls, after reaching a partial write.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel budget was consumed by probe fan-out and retries before implementation; serial budget was consumed by local overanalysis and incomplete assembly.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both modes failed the completed official evaluator at 0/40, so there is no official outcome discordance to explain. The concrete task-solving difference is artifact progress: parallel exhausted the budget in a probe workflow and produced no files, while serial performed similar behavioral analysis locally and began an output tree but missed the required root entry file.
parallel_contributors: Probe fan-out and repeated stalled child retries prevented the later implementer from running.
The final artifact directory was empty, so the evaluator had no usable Rust entry point.
serial_contributors: Serial kept context local and reached a construction step under /output/src/color.
Serial still failed because it timed out before creating the required root test11.rs and complete Cargo package.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's defect is ordinary incomplete packaging/root-file placement rather than a concurrency pattern.
Parallel had no final implementation to compare for algorithmic correctness.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No outcome differential; retained parallel pattern explains an adverse process difference within a both-fail pair, not an exclusive root cause for a discordant score.
